accessNotes: The 25-page 'Data Visualization Guidelines' pocket stylebook (Luis Ahumada Abrigo & Guillermina Sutter Schneider) was downloaded from the GitHub repo; text extracted with pypdf and pages rendered with ImageMagick. Hex codes are stated in the PDF; the fourth categorical colour 'light purple' is not labelled on the chart page but matches the stated dark-purple tone #716A8A (verified by sampling the rendered example). Tables/web pages pages 11-13 are text-only.
summary: Think-tank publication standard derived from Cato's Infogram style. Austere, print-report look: ITC Franklin Gothic in #222222, 'FIGURE 1' label above a short bold sentence-case title and regular subtitle, no gridlines, a plain baseline, data labels outside bars, round-dot legend centred at the bottom, and a strict colour order of dark purple #28223C, orange #ED8B00, grey #C7C7C7, light purple, with never more than four colours.

colors.categoricalNotes: One group: dark purple. Two: dark purple + orange. Three: dark purple, orange, grey. Four: dark purple, orange, grey, light purple. Five or more groups are not allowed in one figure (consolidate or split into two or three charts); never more than four colours in a single layout. Use the same colour for the same variable across all charts in a publication. Grey for less important elements so primary colours stand out. Alternative system (use sparingly, not brand identifiers): election data Republican #B72025 (subset #D26563), Democrat #2565AA (subset #739CC8), Independent #F5AA1C (subset #F9D083); gender data Female #C01E65 (subset #DC7EA9), Male #117AB3 (subset #7CB6D6); grey scale #131313, #696A6A, #9C9C9C, #D9DAD9.
colors.notes: Primary colour tones: dark purple #28223C -> #716A8A -> #A9A4BD; orange #ED8B00 -> #F4C684 -> #FBDEB5; grey #C7C7C7 -> #E5E5E5. Sequential (maps): dark purple #28223C for highest value to light purple #D0CDDB for lowest, single hue varying opacity. All chart text #222222.

axisTitle.placement: y-axis title rotated 90° beside the axis; x-axis title centred below the category labels

typography.notes: Print spec (pt, all #222222): figure number 13pt ('FIGURE 1', uppercase); title 14pt bold; subtitle 14pt regular; axis labels 12pt; y-axis title 13pt; x-axis title 13pt; data labels 12pt; legend 12pt; notes 10pt; source 11pt. Pixel values above = pt x 4/3. 'Titles should be short with the first word capitalized'; 'Subtitles should also be short with the first word capitalized'. Don't use bold, italic, underline or distracting fonts within the chart.

structure.axisLine: Thin light-grey x baseline only; no y axis line.
structure.zeroLine: Baseline at zero shown as thin grey line.
structure.yAxisTitle: rotated vertical, left of the tick labels
structure.notes: Keep charts visually simple: no illustrations, drop shadows, ornamentation or 3D.

legend.title: no
legend.notes: 'Legends should be placed at the bottom of the chart.' Legend sits below the x-axis title, above notes and source.

marks.bars: Flat solid fills, no outlines, no rounding; grouped bars touch within a group with clear gaps between groups. Column charts sorted with highest value on the left. Use bar (horizontal) charts for long labels.
marks.lines: Medium-thick (~2-3px) solid lines without markers; no more than two trend lines compared.
marks.areas: Area charts (stacked/100% stacked) for multiple categories over time.
marks.points: Scatter/grouped scatter/dot plot listed as allowed types.
marks.pies: Pie only with few values: no more than four slices, otherwise bar or column. Don't use multiple pies to compare sets of shares (use stacked bars). Doughnut and semicircle variants listed.
marks.notes: Line charts only for change over time; stacked columns should not be used for time data (use line/area).

labels.dataLabels: Print: placed outside (above/after) the bar or column, 12pt #222222. Web (Infogram): data labels turned off; values shown on hover.
labels.notes: Tables: first column left-aligned; all other columns (headers and values) right-aligned.

furniture.title: Stack above the plot, left-aligned: 'FIGURE 1' (13pt, uppercase) then short bold title (14pt) then short regular subtitle (14pt).
furniture.source: Below legend and notes, left-aligned: 'Source: Author, Title (Publisher, year).' with 'Source' bold and underlined, 11pt.
furniture.other: Notes line preceded by asterisk ('*We have omitted ...') 10pt, above the source. Figures numbered.

layout: Fixed widths: Policy Analysis print figures/tables 750px; non-PA print figures 1,000px; web studies & blog posts 650px. Web tables with 7+ rows get a scroll bar; 5+ columns and 7+ rows get a search bar.
interaction: Web figures built in Infogram show values on hover instead of persistent data labels.

distinctiveRules.rule: Colour assignment by group count: 1 = dark purple #28223C; 2 = + orange #ED8B00; 3 = + grey #C7C7C7; 4 = + light purple #716A8A.
distinctiveRules.quote: For three color groups, use dark purple, orange, and grey.

distinctiveRules.rule: No more than four groups/colours in a figure; five or more must be consolidated or split.
distinctiveRules.quote: There should not be five or more groups in a single figure.

distinctiveRules.rule: Legend at the bottom of the chart, centred, round dot swatches.
distinctiveRules.quote: Legends should be placed at the bottom of the chart.

distinctiveRules.rule: Title block: uppercase 'FIGURE n' label, then 14pt bold title and 14pt regular subtitle, both sentence case, left-aligned, #222222.
distinctiveRules.quote: Titles should be short with the first word capitalized; ITC Franklin Gothic Std 14 pt, Bold #222222

distinctiveRules.rule: All chart text is ITC Franklin Gothic Std in #222222.
distinctiveRules.quote: ITC Franklin Gothic, the font that will be used for all our figures and tables

distinctiveRules.rule: Print data labels sit outside the bar/column end, 12pt #222222; web charts hide labels and use hover.
distinctiveRules.quote: Should be placed outside the bar or column. Font size: 12 pt. Color: #222222.

distinctiveRules.rule: No gridlines; only a thin grey baseline; rotated y-axis title.
distinctiveRules.quote: Specification figure shows y-axis title rotated, no gridlines

distinctiveRules.rule: Source line bottom-left with bold underlined 'Source:' at 11pt; notes above it with asterisk at 10pt.
distinctiveRules.quote: Source: James Gwartney et al., Economic Freedom of the World ...

distinctiveRules.rule: Maps use a single-hue purple sequential scale: #28223C for highest, #D0CDDB for lowest.
distinctiveRules.quote: Dark purple is strongly recommended for the highest value and light purple for the lowest value.

distinctiveRules.rule: Columns are ordered with the highest value on the left.
distinctiveRules.quote: always create a column chart placing the highest value on the left and lower values to the right
A pie chart should be divided into no more than four slices.

distinctiveRules.rule: Fixed figure widths: 650px web, 750px Policy Analysis print, 1,000px other print studies.
distinctiveRules.quote: figures in PAs must have a fixed width of 750 px ... Figures must have a fixed width of 650 px.

distinctiveRules.rule: Election and gender data use a separate alternative palette (Republican #B72025, Democrat #2565AA, Independent #F5AA1C; Female #C01E65, Male #117AB3) with lighter tints for subsets.
distinctiveRules.quote: Use them to visualize gender or election data

distinctiveRules.rule: Grey for less important elements so primary colours mark the most important data.
distinctiveRules.quote: DO CONSIDER USING GREY FOR LESS IMPORTANT ELEMENTS

referenceImages.describes: Print figure specification (page 10). Grouped column chart, left-aligned header: small uppercase 'FIGURE 1', bold title 'Titles should be short with the first word capitalized', regular subtitle beneath. Three groups of three touching columns in dark purple #28223C, orange #ED8B00, light grey; integer data labels above each column in small black; y tick labels 0-8 left, rotated 'Y-axis title'; no gridlines, no y-axis line, thin light-grey baseline; category labels 'Label' under groups; centred 'X-axis title'; legend centred below with round dots 'Set 1 / Set 2 / Set 3'; notes line beginning with '*' and 'Source:' (bold, underlined) bottom-left in small type. Orange callouts give sizes: figure no. 13pt, title 14pt Bold, subtitle 14pt, default font 12-13pt, notes 10pt, source 11pt, all #222222.

Visual cues diagram (page 9): same grouped column chart annotated with red labels naming Figure number, Title, Subtitle, Axis label, Y-axis title, Data label, X-axis title, Legend, Notes and Source, confirming their positions (all left-aligned header stack, bottom-centred legend, notes and source bottom-left).

Colour implementation page: for one, two and three categories, column, horizontal bar and line mini-charts. One category all dark purple; two categories orange then dark purple; three categories add light grey. Flat bars with no axes or gridlines, lines thick without markers; tiny legend dots at bottom.
Four categories add light purple #716A8A; five-category versions crossed out with red X; US choropleth in purple sequential ramp with swatches #28223C (dark) and #D0CDDB (light).
